children: New Delhi, Sept. 20 -- Shafali Verma became the first woman to score a hundred in the women's cricket event at the Asian Games on Sunday, en route to her maiden hundred in white-ball cricket. The Indian opener, who has been in tremendous form from the Asia Cup, reached the milestone on the finl delivery of the Indian innings against Bangladesh in the second semifinal in Nisshin.
